# Deanna Tran

## Bio
Deanna Tran is a Senior Product Engineer at Cloudflare in NYC, working across security and trust teams. She ramps up fast in ambiguity — whether it's a new codebase, a new team, or a product pivot. She tries to fix workflows, not just digitize broken ones, with a passion at the intersection of business, product, and engineering.

Before Cloudflare, she was at early-stage startups spinning up design systems and executing rapid product pivots.

Outside of work, she's a lifelong tinkerer and loves her cat, Lion.
